usedFor: ManyContacts captures chat contacts and Sangam CRM keeps your leads, so “New Contact” in ManyContacts feeds “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ManyContacts, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: New contacts become leads without retyping, and an existing lead is updated instead of doubled.

watchOut: “New Contact” in ManyContacts is polling, so a lead appears after a scheduled check.
